prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in hints, preset customization fallback flow, sequence reordering, interactive waiting flows/tips, interactive hotkey setup screen, and desktop welcome quick-action redesign were helpful.
Hints outside of sign-in, copy updates, layout changes, and sign-in reordering showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Most new screens hurt performance or showed no clear effect, except for the interactive desktop hotkey setup screen.
Predictions overestimated gains for failed, harmful, or no-effect changes.
Predictions were too low for unexpected winning changes such as sequence reordering, interactive waiting flows, hotkey setup screen, and desktop quick-action redesign.

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Pet Habit Training Screen: Insert an interactive habit schedule screen while pet desktop files render so users can configure daily pet check-ins. (why: Waiting in home screen takes a long median time of 201s (mean 2336s); interactive wait setup screens improved completion in earlier iterations.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Pet Session Recovery Hint: Add an explicit session recovery hint to sign_in informing users that logging in restores past pets and data. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
2: [home, wait_info] Interactive Wait Screen Activity Status: Display interactive initialization stages and time estimates on the waiting screen as pet assets build. (why: Home waiting stage has a high mean duration of 2336s; clear waiting statuses keep users engaged during setup.)
3: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Headline: Update the home_intro headline and body to highlight essential keyboard hotkeys for pet visibility. (why: Support inbox received 3 tickets from users confused about how to hide or summon their pet after finishing setup.)
4: [adoption, layout] Compact Adoption Certificate Layout: Switch adoption_certificate to a compact layout with an embedded mascot preview component. (why: Adoption stage is the biggest bottleneck at 62.7% conversion; compact layout streamlines finalizing companion adoption.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Ready System Notification: Enable background notify_when_ready system notification toggle on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step takes a long mean time of 2336s, indicating users minimize or leave the desktop app while waiting.)

scores.note: Interactive waiting screens have shown positive gains (+0.4% to +1.5%), but building a new screen carries high implementation cost.
Sign-in hints consistently perform well (+3.0%), supported strongly by 8 support tickets and drop-off data.
Interactive waiting flows and status updates consistently improve retention during long load times (+1.5% measured).
Copy changes on finish step historically underperform (-3.9%), despite support ticket evidence.
Adoption step has high drop-off (62.7%), but layout changes historically show negative relative gains (-2.1%).
Addresses extreme mean wait time (2336s) with low implementation cost, aligning with positive home step flow trends.
